basic_details.job_title: Sainik School Purulia Recruitment 2026 – Walkin for TGT, Art Master Posts
basic_details.short_information: Sainik School Purulia will hold a walk-in interview at 0830 hrs on 23 November 2026 at Sainik School Purulia (PO Sainik School-723104, Dist Purulia (WB)). Three posts are to be filled on an ad hoc basis: one TGT (Social Science) and one TGT (Hindi) at a consolidated salary of Rs. 25,000/- per month each, and one Art Master (UR) at Rs. 21,000/- per month. Candidates aged 21 to 35 years as on 01 Nov 2026 who meet the post's eligibility may attend with their application, bio-data and certificates.

age_limit.details: The age limit for all three posts is 21 – 35 years as on 01 November 2026. The notice does not mention any age relaxation.

content_sections.heading: About Sainik School Purulia
content_sections.text: Sainik School Purulia is a school located at PO Sainik School-723104 in Purulia district, West Bengal, as printed on the notice's letterhead. This walk-in interview is for teaching posts at the school itself, and the notice is issued "By Order, Sainik School Purulia".

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: The notice prints a category only for the Art Master post (UR). No category is printed for the two TGT posts. Eligibility: Graduate with two subjects History and Political Science and B.Ed from a recognized university/ institute. Or B.A. B.Ed with Social Science (History and Political Science) of the Regional College of Education. Desirable: Teaching experience in English Medium Residential School. Knowledge in Computer Applications. Obtained minimum 50% marks in Graduation and B Ed. Eligibility: A Bachelor's degree with Hindi studied as an elective/main subject for at least three years (six semesters) and B.Ed from recognized university/institute. Or Four-year integrated degree from an NCTE-recognised institution with the required subject combination. Desirable: Teaching experience in English Medium Residential School. Knowledge in Computer Applications. Obtained minimum 50% marks in Graduation and B Ed. Eligibility: B. Fine Arts or Five years' recognized Diploma in Drawing and Painting / Sculpture / Graphic Art. Or equivalent degree from a recognized university. Desirable: Past teaching experience in an English Medium Residential School. Proficiency in Games & Sports, NCC and co-curricular activities like music, dance / drama would be preferred. The age limit for all three posts is 21 – 35 years as on 01 November 2026. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. All three posts carry a consolidated salary: Rs. 25,000/- per month for TGT (Social Science) and TGT (Hindi), and Rs. 21,000/- per month for Art Master. The notice does not mention any allowance on top of the consolidated salary. The appointment for each post is on an ad hoc basis. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Application Bio-data Original certificates Attested copies of certificates and marks sheets The notice does not include an application form or prescribe a format for the application; candidates bring their own application with them on the day.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be given for attending the walk-in interview. The school administration reserves the right to cancel the vacancy due to administrative/policy reason. All three posts are on an ad hoc basis, not regular appointments.

faq.question: Q1. When is the Sainik School Purulia walk-in interview 2026?
faq.answer: The Sainik School Purulia walk-in interview is on 23 November 2026, with candidates to attend at 0830 hrs.

faq.question: Q2. Where is the Sainik School Purulia walk-in interview held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is held at Sainik School Purulia, PO Sainik School-723104, Dist Purulia (WB).

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are there in Sainik School Purulia Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: one TGT (Social Science), one TGT (Hindi) and one Art Master (UR), all on an ad hoc basis.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Sainik School Purulia TGT (Social Science)?
faq.answer: Candidates need to be a graduate with two subjects History and Political Science and B.Ed from a recognized university/institute, or hold a B.A. B.Ed with Social Science (History and Political Science) of the Regional College of Education.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification for the Sainik School Purulia Art Master post?
faq.answer: The Art Master post requires a B. Fine Arts or five years' recognized Diploma in Drawing and Painting / Sculpture / Graphic Art, or an equivalent degree from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for the Sainik School Purulia posts?
faq.answer: The age limit is 21 – 35 years as on 01 November 2026 for all three posts.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for Sainik School Purulia TGT and Art Master posts?
faq.answer: TGT (Social Science) and TGT (Hindi) carry a consolidated salary of Rs. 25,000/- per month, and Art Master carries Rs. 21,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I bring to the Sainik School Purulia walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Bring your application, bio-data, original certificates and attested copies of certificates and marks sheets.

faq.question: Q9. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be given.

faq.question: Q10. Are the Sainik School Purulia posts permanent?
faq.answer: No. All three posts are on an ad hoc basis, and the school administration reserves the right to cancel the vacancy due to administrative/policy reason.
